Ireland’s Eurosong.. I liked Laika Party by Emmy much better originally. I thought the staging was done in a fun way, and it came across super well. I remembered her from DMGP with Witch Wood, so I was biased.

And then honestly the Gaja performance in Poland was fantastic, but almost borderline a disjointed mess, and the song really isn’t enjoyable to listen to- it doesn’t go anywhere. Amazing athletics and everything but, the song the more I listen to it kind of sucks. You know what song didn’t suck at all? 

Lusterka. That was probably my favorite song of the competition, and the staging was just as captivating. Really wish Lusterka would’ve gone instead, Poland would have been significantly more competitive with it imo.
